decision_reasons.fail: Neither clip-grid Premium residual multiplier cleared the pre-registered residual-cap, official-safety, Fast/Balanced identity, or Dev veto gates. Keep the current runtime. Do not add a post-hoc multiplier outside this grid.
decision_reasons.pass: A clip-grid Premium residual multiplier kept Fast/Balanced identical, held official Train/Dev off the near-budget line, and brought residual-only Premium under the official cap including inflation. This opens a promotion window only.

metric.definition: Official weighted final score on the full Train and Dev batches. Residual-only and other composition views replay the allocator. Fast/Balanced identity is bit-exact versus shipped.
metric.selection: Smaller residual multiplier among arms that pass every safety gate. Dev official score is a veto, not a ranking objective.
